messages.subject: How to insert JavaScript?
parts:
Here is my ui.R:

library(shiny)

shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(  
  headerPanel("Title"),
  
  sidebarPanel(
    tags$textarea(id="foo","some text")
  ),
  
  mainPanel(
    includeHTML("autoselect.js")
  )
))


while my autoselect.js is:

<script type="text/javascript">
    var textBox = document.getElementById("foo");
    textBox.onfocus = function() {
        textBox.select()};
    };
</script>

But it seems not working. What is the correct way of doing so? Thank you.

But when I am fiddling I find other problems. But the console reports that Uncaught TypeError: Object [object Object] has no method 'autoresize' . How can I resolve this? Thank you very much!

messages.author: f806781d102fe0ab
messages.subject: Re: How to insert JavaScript?
parts:
Exactly, or directly under www and src="autoselect.js" (though aesthetically I think Burkhard's arrangement is better).

It's a common pitfall of HTML in general that you can NEVER do:

<script type="text/javascript" src="autoselect.js"/>

instead you MUST ALWAYS include the closing tag explicitly:

<script type="text/javascript" src="autoselect.js"></script>

See:
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/69913/why-dont-self-closing-script-tags-work
http://tiffanybbrown.com/2011/03/23/html5-does-not-allow-self-closing-tags/
